contraindication.definition: A condition in which the medicine must not be used, because the risk outweighs the benefit.
contraindication.example: Pregnancy is a contraindication for this medicine, so I will ask about an alternative.

happy.definition: A warm, good feeling inside. It makes you want to smile and share.
happy.example: I feel happy when my friend sits with me.

mathlit_plausibility.definition: The quality of a situation that could happen, even when it did not.
mathlit_plausibility.example: The story has plausibility, and the details of the rule are still missing.

root.definition: The part of a plant that grows down into the soil, to hold it up and drink water.
root.example: The root drank the rain deep in the ground.

sorry.definition: The word you say when you did something wrong. It shows you take responsibility.
sorry.example: Sorry, I stepped on your foot.
